content.value: Parties are persistent groups of up to 10 players. The party HUD shows member health information, same-party direct PvP damage is cancelled, and combat XP can be shared.

/party create — create a party and become leader.
/party invite <player> — leader invites an online player; invite expires after 2 minutes.
/party accept <leader> — accept that leader's pending invite.
/party info — list members and leader.
/party kick <player> — leader removes a member.
/party leader <player> — transfer leadership to a member.
/party leave — leave; if the leader leaves, leadership passes to the next member or the one-person party disbands.
/party disband — leader removes the party.

Damage contribution is grouped by party. The party with the highest combined contribution wins kill credit. Online members in the same dimension and within 100 blocks are eligible. With two or more eligible members, each receives ceil(base XP / eligible count x 1.2). The highest Combat Experience bonus among those members scales the pool first.
The 20% party bonus applies only when at least two members are eligible near the kill. A distant or cross-dimensional member receives nothing and does not divide the share.
